items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I would like to say Sam Morgan and the other Sam used to come over

ctx.x: I began to find out that a piece of audio can be played not only in just one key, and several keys could be played. So, watching carefully at Warren, I found out... Thank you. Want to offer? Thank you. I could play one key to the other. And, uh... I might say, I bought this on myself. This experiment, you understand what I mean? I tried it here, and then I hit another chord, and I found that's another, and then I tried that. I came to find out I played a piece in five or six different keys. Now, the main…
Well, how many, how many pieces are you all?
